title: Subject:
prompt:
Subject:
Looking back with rainbow ruffles

Main Subject:
A female performer in her 20s looking back over her shoulder with her back turned on a large stage glowing with purple and pink lighting. A slender full body is placed largely in the center of the frame, making the pink microphone in her left hand and the glittering pastel-colored ruffled outfit the main highlights.

Person & Expression:
A slender oval face, sharp dark brown eyes, thin well-groomed eyebrows, a small nose, and glossy coral pink lips. Turning her face over her left shoulder toward the camera, she casts a direct gaze with a confident expression, smiling softly only with her mouth. Dark dark brown long hair down below her chest, thin textured bangs, and gently waving strands. The tips of her hair blow lightly to the right of the screen due to the stage wind.

Clothing & Pose:
An idol-style two-piece outfit layering pale light blue, pink, lavender, and yellow. The short top with thin shoulder straps features jewel-like decorations, gold trimming, and light blue ruffles under the chest. On the waist are glossy light blue shorts and translucent multi-tiered organza ruffles layered asymmetrically, with a long tail-like fabric hanging down to the right side of the screen. Facing diagonally backwards, twisting her waist to the left of the screen, and shifting her weight to her left leg. Extending her left arm diagonally backwards and downwards to hold the pink microphone, while extending her right arm to the right of the screen with a lightly clenched fist.

Background & Lighting:
A large LED screen displaying abstract patterns of pink, light blue, and yellow on the left of the screen. White, purple, and pink round stage lights dot the right, top, and bottom, with the background shifting from dark blue to black. Intense purple and pink direct lights strike from the back right and above, creating a vivid magenta rim light on the outline of her hair, shoulders, and outfit. A soft white fill light from the front keeps her face and skin bright.

Composition & Camera:
Vertical 2:3 ratio. A telephoto camera shot from a slightly low angle, as if looking up from the audience seating, capturing from the crown of the head to near below the knees. The figure is placed prominently in the center of the frame, with the face towards the top, the multi-tiered ruffles at the waist in the center, and both hands extended left and right near the edges of the frame. The left microphone is fully included without being cut off, and both legs are cut off at the bottom edge. Sharp focus on the face and outfit, with a shallow depth of field creating large circular bokeh from the LEDs and lights.

Texture & Style:
A photorealistic live-action photo of a live performance captured with a telephoto lens. High-definition details of natural skin texture, fine reflections on long hair, the sheerness and layering of organza, glitter, beads, jewel-like decorations, and a metallic mesh microphone. Keeps purple, pink, and light blue vibrant without blowing out the details of her face and outfit even under intense stage lights.

Negative:
Omission of looking back from behind and the microphone, changing to a solid-colored outfit.
